Definition: Gomer, the name of a son of Japheth and of his descendants; also of a Hebrewess
BiblicalUsage: Gomer = "complete"; n pr m; 1) the eldest son of Japheth and grandson of Noah; the progenitor of the early Cimmerians and other branches of the Celtic family; n pr f; 2) the unfaithful wife of the prophet Hosea; Hosea's relationship with her was symbolic of God's relationship with wayward Israel
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
